title: Navy astronomer measures wobbling disc

tellings.quote: New Mexico, this is in uh the very famous Life magazine article of 1947. One of the Navy's top astronomers observes

plain: In 1947 in New Mexico, one of the Navy's top astronomers is said to have watched and measured a wobbling disc in the sky. The researcher Marik von Rennenkampff brings it up on the show without naming his source. He says it appeared in a well-known 1947 Life magazine article, which would mean a trained scientist working for the military reported such a sighting that year.
